lines.zh: 这段回廊，我一天走四十趟。
lines.en: Forty laps of this cloister, every day.

lines.zh: 盾沿擦着地砖，声音是记号。
lines.en: My shield's rim scrapes the tiles as a marker.
I take the outer side; the wall is yours.

lines.zh: 脚步声要匀，巡逻才像样。
lines.en: Even footsteps make a proper patrol.
The inner door has only this line.

lines.zh: 甲片响一下，我就知道方位。
lines.en: One clink of plate tells me where I am.

lines.zh: 我从东廊走到西廊，不抄近路。
lines.en: East cloister to west, never a shortcut.

lines.zh: 地砖第七块是空的，绕开。
lines.en: The seventh tile is hollow; step around it.
My shadow hits the doorframe first.

lines.zh: 走路别看天花板，梁上有人。
lines.en: Do not watch the ceiling; someone is on the beams.
Someone crossed this line yesterday.

lines.zh: 我把靴印留在该留的地方。
lines.en: I leave bootprints only where they belong.
The door stands, and so do I.
I count bricks; the bricks count me.
The inner hall's lamp must not go out.
My shoulders stiffen from standing so long.

lines.zh: 谁把盾靠在墙上了？是我。
lines.en: Who leaned the shield on the wall? I did.

lines.zh: 圣所的钥匙，挂在我腰后。
lines.en: The sanctum keys hang behind my belt.
I hear the door hinge complaining.
The relief guard is always half a bell late.
Wind came through a crack; I plugged it.
My post must not stand empty.
You stand outside the line. Good.

lines.zh: 我看你的脚，不看你的脸。
lines.en: I watch your feet, not your face.
Palms open; turn around slowly.

lines.zh: 你腰上那个凸起是什么？
lines.en: What is that bulge at your waist?

lines.zh: 你的鞋底带泥，走的是后门。
lines.en: Mud on your soles — you came by the back door.
Do not lean on the door; the door matters more.
I watch you until you leave.
Your breathing is quick, like a runner's.
Look up if you like; do not raise your hands.

lines.zh: 我认识这身衣服，不属于圣所。
lines.en: I know that garb; it is not the sanctum's.
A dent in the plate; it still blocks.

lines.zh: 打我不算本事，推开才算。
lines.en: Hitting me proves nothing; pushing me does.
That half step was just a change of foot.
Not the shield; it numbs my arm.

lines.zh: 盾上的凹痕，我留着当记号。
lines.en: I keep that dent as a marker.
If the door is fine, so am I.
Strong arms, wrong road.
Sand in the plate joint annoys more than the wound.

lines.zh: 我站着挨打，是因为不能退。
lines.en: I take hits because I cannot retreat.
Again; my shield is still up.
Put it on the ground and back away three steps.
Emeralds cannot buy a door.
I take no gifts, only passes.

lines.zh: 你举得再高，我也不伸手。
lines.en: Raise it higher; I still will not reach.
Food? I eat only at the change of guard.
That iron could mend the hinge.

lines.zh: 诱惑放在线外，人就安全。
lines.en: Temptation outside the line keeps people safe.

lines.zh: 我的手套厚，抓不住小东西。
lines.en: My gloves are thick; small things slip.
You are willing to give; I dare not take.

lines.zh: 圣所的仓库，钥匙不在我手上。
lines.en: The storeroom key is not mine to take.
Hit the door if you must, not me.
There is no padding under this breastplate.

lines.zh: 退后，你踩住我的站位了。
lines.en: Back up; you are standing on my mark.
I will call that a stumble.
Push again and the frame cracks.
I have measured this door with my shoulder.

lines.zh: 你撞得动我，撞不动规矩。
lines.en: You can move me, not the rule.

lines.zh: 站稳，别把泥蹭到我甲上。
lines.en: Steady; keep your mud off my plate.

lines.zh: 让开半步，那是我转身的地方。
lines.en: Half a step — that is where I turn.

lines.zh: 碰撞记一次，下次就拦你。
lines.en: One bump logged; next time I block you.

lines.zh: 守门的人，没有换班的伴。
lines.en: A gatekeeper has no partner to relieve him.
I am wed to this door.
Comrades, yes; a household, no.

lines.zh: 圣所的孩子，都是抱进来的。
lines.en: The sanctum's children are all carried in.

lines.zh: 两个人站岗，会一起打瞌睡。
lines.en: Two on watch would doze together.

lines.zh: 我的盾够宽，遮不住两个人。
lines.en: My shield is wide, but not for two.

lines.zh: 誓言我只会念守门那一句。
lines.en: I know only the gatekeeper's oath.
Stop asking; idle talk is barred inside.
I carved my name inside the door.

lines.zh: 我这副肩甲，留给下一班。
lines.en: This pauldron goes to the next shift.
Anything dropped inside the line, I collect.
Whose pass is this?
I bend, but my eyes stay on the door.

lines.zh: 捡起来要登记，交给书记。
lines.en: Found items get logged with the clerk.
A nail? Just right for the door plank.
Leave it; someone else dropped that.

lines.zh: 我手上有甲，捏不稳细东西。
lines.en: Armored hands cannot hold fine things.

lines.zh: 这枚钥匙，开的是哪扇门？
lines.en: Which door does this key open?

lines.zh: 圣所的失物，都堆在门房。
lines.en: Lost property piles up in the gatehouse.
What I pick up belongs to the sanctum.
Stop outside the line; no further.
The inner door does not open today.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声太重，是外人。
lines.en: Your footsteps are heavy — an outsider.
I saw you come over the low wall.
Hands out of your pockets.
You should not have that key.

lines.zh: 圣所的内部，不接待访客。
lines.en: The sanctum's interior receives no visitors.

lines.zh: 我举起盾，就是最后警告。
lines.en: My shield raised is the final warning.

lines.zh: 有个人在数我们的岗哨。
lines.en: Someone is counting our posts.
Halt; you stepped on the hollow tile.
I know the way behind that door; you do not.
Set down that torch first.

lines.zh: 退回去，或者被我推回去。
lines.en: Turn back, or be pushed back.

lines.zh: 圣所的墙，比你的耐心厚。
lines.en: These walls are thicker than your patience.

lines.zh: 你把门推开了一条缝，我看见了。
lines.en: You pushed the door open a crack. I saw it.
Go left; I block left.
No need to chase; there is one door.
Shield facing you means the road is gone.

lines.zh: 你的影子在我盾上，跑不掉。
lines.en: Your shadow is on my shield; you cannot run.
Two more steps and you enter the dead corner.

lines.zh: 我数你的脚步，比数砖容易。
lines.en: Counting your steps is easier than counting bricks.
You circle; I pivot in place.

lines.zh: 举着武器的手，先被拦下。
lines.en: Armed hands get stopped first.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊了会惊动内殿。
lines.en: I do not shout; it would disturb the inner hall.

lines.zh: 你的退路，我早上就封了。
lines.en: I sealed your retreat this morning.
Do not touch the bar; that is mine.

lines.zh: 你在犹豫，我已经站定了。
lines.en: You hesitate; I have already set my feet.

lines.zh: 过来吧，我等着收你的武器。
lines.en: Come on; I am waiting to take your weapon.
You will not cross this line.

lines.zh: 你的手往腰上摸，那不行。
lines.en: Your hand drifts to your belt. That will not do.

lines.zh: 我在门口站成一根柱子。
lines.en: I plant myself in the doorway like a post.
You shifted weight to your other foot, ready to charge.

lines.zh: 这条走廊的每一块砖都听我的。
lines.en: Every brick in this hall answers to me.
The shield arrives first, then me.

lines.zh: 这一下，是把你推回线外。
lines.en: This shove puts you back outside the line.
My fist is wrapped in iron.
Do not block it; the rim is blunt but heavy.
Hold still; I dislike striking twice.
You retreat, and the door is safe.
I strike quietly to save breath.

lines.zh: 甲片撞在一起，就是号令。
lines.en: Clashing plate is the signal.
This blow counts as three warnings.
Too close to the door; I had to act.
My arm is harder than the door bar.
Fall inside the line and I drag you out.
Do not grab my shield; it will not help.

lines.zh: 站好，下一击送你回廊外。
lines.en: Stand; the next blow sends you to the outer hall.
My shield rim presses on your collarbone.

lines.zh: 这一推，把你送回台阶下。
lines.en: This shove sends you back below the steps.
Change of guard; keys handed over.

lines.zh: 我站上这块砖，就算到岗。
lines.en: I stand on this tile, and my post begins.
Door intact, lock intact, I have arrived.
The inner hall's lamp still burns. Good.

lines.zh: 昨晚是谁值的班？砖歪了。
lines.en: Who had the watch? A tile is askew.
I lift my shield from the wall.
The sanctum hinges stay quiet today.

lines.zh: 甲片有点凉，站一会就热。
lines.en: The plate is cold; standing warms it.

lines.zh: 我来了，这条线就有人守。
lines.en: I am here, so this line is held.

lines.zh: 名册上添一笔：护门者到。
lines.en: One entry added: the door warden is in.

lines.zh: 台阶上的落叶，等会再扫。
lines.en: Leaves on the steps can wait.
I check the door first, then the people.
Keep that torch steady; the beams are wood.
The steps are slick; I did say so.

lines.zh: 内殿的地下水，涨得真快。
lines.en: The inner hall's groundwater rises fast.
The door remains; the frame is gone.

lines.zh: 箭插在甲上，拔出来还能用。
lines.en: The arrow stuck in my plate; I can pull it out.
The spell went around my shield.
Guards often forget to eat.

lines.zh: 雷打在门楼上，我在下面。
lines.en: Lightning struck the gatehouse; I stood below.
No tiles underfoot, only black.
